finding.title: M2 'Complete' status omits source-asserted limits of Cocoa records
finding.message: The report states the total is 323 inputs / 202 observations across six catalogue/text records. The records.json inputs sum to 57+30+47+71+50+68=323, and observations sum to 21+23+41+42+42+33=202, so this matches. However, the README table lists the tab/Breadcrumb/Color results as 'stages' and 'transitions' while the summary results are PASS_SOURCE_ASSERTED_*, yet delivery spec says 'Complete' without qualifying these as source-asserted only.
finding.suggestion: State in the M2 status row that the three dedicated Cocoa records are source-asserted, not native-snapshot verified.

discarded.reason: quoted evidence not found in specs/macos-delivery.md
